fact: A BCEAO instruction signed 8 October 2026 (in force 2 November 2026) amends the rules for e-money issuers, setting a 4 million FCFA holding cap per identified client, a 15 million FCFA monthly reload cap with BCEAO prior authorisation above it, and at least 65% of outstanding e-money in sight deposits.
title: UMOA : la BCEAO relève les plafonds de monnaie électronique et encadre les placements
